whatTheOrchestratorProvides: deciding when a world-wide story is worth writing and delegating that assignment
supplying the creative guidance and series context the assignment carries
reviewing every candidate before it becomes visible and deciding what enters the archive
running the publish workflow and the source capture that follows it
decoupling.workload: The shipped integration template world-narrative-coordinator/integration/workflows/director-post-with-narratives is a six-node top-level workflow: post-turn director update, two dispatches, one review, two publishes. A decoupled card writes an equivalent orchestration of its own and wires it to a trigger.
riskIfDecoupled: no world-logic review of a candidate before players can read it
no deep-director material to draw subjects from, so the card supplies its own prompts and series plan
no cross-module hard-conflict check, so two modules can publish contradictory events
